references.text: God's original instruction to Moses that the lampstand and all its utensils should be made from one talent of pure gold.
Description of the utensils belonging to the lampstand: tongs and fire pans of pure gold.
The complete description of how Bezalel made the lampstand and all its parts from pure gold.
Confirms that the lampstand was made of hammered gold, in accordance with the pattern the Lord had shown Moses.
The lampstands in Solomon's temple were also made of pure gold, following the same tradition.
The golden lampstands are mentioned as part of the temple furnishings to be used in worship.
Conclusion on the work confirming that the lampstand was completed with all its accessories according to the instruction.
